fl_vs_local_conclusion: FL produced a numerically higher AUROC than local-only by approximately +0.0068 [95% CI -0.0031 to +0.0179], but the CI includes zero and the difference is not statistically supported at the 95% level.
fedprox_note: At mu=0.1 the proximal gradient was 1.3% of the data gradient (median across non-initial local steps; IQR 0.8–1.7%). Conclude: the proximal correction was negligible under the evaluated configuration, consistent with limited optimisation heterogeneity across clients at the configured number of local steps. Dataset homogeneity is not definitively established by this observation alone.

manuscript_conclusions.ni_primary: FedAvg (primary NI analysis); FedProx, FedAvg-equal, SCAFFOLD, FedAdam are secondary
manuscript_conclusions.ni_result: All five FL methods were non-inferior to centralized training (one-sided 95% LCB > -0.02 AUROC) across 23 LOCO clients
manuscript_conclusions.fl_vs_local: FedAvg produced a numerically higher AUROC than local-only training, with a paired difference of +0.007 [95% CI: -0.003, 0.018]; the interval included zero.
manuscript_conclusions.longtail: The centralized logistic model trained on 23 primary providers achieved AUROC 0.807 [0.785, 0.829] and risk-positive PR-AUC 0.900 [0.882, 0.917], corresponding to a 1.33x lift over the long-tail cohort's nonadherence prevalence of 0.677. This evaluates within-source provider transportability, not external generalization.
